correctness.rationale: A prefix-normal positive-weight word starts with 1. A factor contains k+1 ones only if it contains a run of k+1 consecutive one positions; the minimal length for such a factor equals that run's span. Thus precisely the prefix-gap versus sliding-gap inequalities in the source are necessary and sufficient, with sizes one and seven automatic. Subtracting one from all distances leaves the homogeneous comparisons unchanged. The trailing zeros are uniquely n−7−sum(s_i), giving lattice points in (n−7)P for n≥7, including the single word at n=7 and none below. Positive strictly increasing gaps scaled to have sum below one show dimension six. Rational Ehrhart gives vol_6(P)n^6+O(n^5). The source checker was inspected but not executed. Fresh exact arithmetic at /workspace/branches/fe2a5143-c775-4a43-954b-d434f70d61eb/independent_volume.py, with output independent_volume.out in that directory, recovered 14 rays from the rank-five active sets and used supporting hyperplanes and pulling (10 outer facets, 15 simplices), not the supplied barycentric subdivision. The sum of exact absolute determinants divided by 6! gave 289/2488320. Dividing by binom(n−1,6) gives 289/3456 for the stated first-symbol conditioning. The computation certifies the numerical volume, not the bijection or Ehrhart argument, which were assessed separately.
